integrity: A deterministic proof is provided with an independent exact-enumeration checker and separate sampling corroboration. No external mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem concerns signed algebraic area (winding-multiplicity area), including self-intersections, not unsigned area or convex hull. Earlier triangle n=3 area moment is implied by a known sphere representation; historical priority for the all-n result remains provisional.
title: Exact algebraic-area variance for edge-permuted closed polygons and Haar–Stiefel polygons
